stories.title: Create audit_log table in Supabase
stories.acceptance_criteria: audit_log table exists with columns: id (UUID PK), action (TEXT with CHECK), target_table (TEXT), target_id (UUID), changed_by (TEXT), old_values (JSONB), new_values (JSONB), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). DDL added to init.py and executes without error.

stories.title: Audit logging service and repository methods
stories.acceptance_criteria: tythe_time_tracker/core/audit.py exists with log_change() function. repository.py has insert_audit_log() and get_audit_logs() methods. log_change() successfully inserts audit records.

stories.title: Wire audit logging into add/edit/delete operations
stories.acceptance_criteria: services.py calls log_change() on add_shift_manually (action='add', new_values captured), edit_shift (action='edit', old and new values captured), and delete_entry (action='delete', old_values captured). changed_by comes from session current_user.

stories.title: Manager changelog view tab
stories.acceptance_criteria: Manager dashboard has a 'Change Log' tab showing audit entries with: timestamp, action, employee affected, changed by, change summary. Filterable by date range, employee name, and action type. Edit entries show before/after diff.
